title: WMO Agreed Basemap WGS 1984 (WKID:4326)
lineage: WMO item states that it is based on UNmap CORE datasets altered for the WMO Agency.
publisher_scale_statement: Suitable for global mapping at the scale of 1:1 million and above.
scale_interpretation: The 1:1,000,000 statement is a cartographic suitability claim, not a certified positional accuracy or source geometry resolution.
tile_resampling_observed: At Germany LOD 9 tile (row 55, column 270), the official service returned a resampled PBF from physical LOD 7 tile (row 13, column 67), reported in x-arcgis-info on 2026-09-26. Offline rendering must support parent-tile fallback.
public_service_capabilities_observed: TilesOnly,Tilemap; exportTilesAllowed=false; no associated public Service2Data item observed on 2026-09-26.
acquisition: Mirror official public vector PBF tiles through first LOD whose nominal scale denominator is <= 1,000,000, plus original style, sprites, glyphs and metadata; keep downloaded files under gitignored data/cache/basemap/wmo.
source_selection: User selected WMO for subsequent NiB basemap work on 2026-09-26. An optional offline WMO vector-tile adapter was implemented on 2026-09-27 for pure basemap and 2D field maps; independent review is pending. Existing VIS-001 OCHA GeoPackage remains the default and reviewed baseline.
usage_boundary: User confirmed this WMO basemap can be used for this project on 2026-09-26. Local cache is for project use; public redistribution or packaging is not asserted by this record.
